prompt_length_audit.count_definition: Whitespace-delimited tokens plus Unicode character and UTF-8 byte counts; no model-specific tokenizer is assumed across six model families.

response_format_and_context_audit.contract: Aggregate-only static audit over all selected items. Multiline lists are kept one element per line; CVLT filler history is stressed with a 1,024-character response; runtime's conservative char/3+64 estimator reserves the complete completion budget for every simulated call.
